name: Living Legends: Frozen Destiny
summary: It’s the night of your family’s grand Winter Ball, the perfect time for you and your beloved, Albert, to announce your engagement! Everything is set for a spectacular evening of fun and romance—until the fabled Ice Queen arrives and kidnaps your fiancé! That’s just the beginning of your troubles. As a dangerous cold sweeps the land and an icy curse is cast on your loved ones, you find yourself with few allies to help you track down the menacing Queen. Can you melt the icy curse, discover your connection to magic, and save the realm in time? Find out in this enchanting Hidden-Object Puzzle adventure!
